t: Ask the Great Mage's soul about his surmises about the Seals and the Great Experiment.

Only dreams of imminent revenge helped me stay sane. Every hour, every minute I'd dream of wiping my boots against the mad necromancer's body. Alas, my dreams were not destined to come true, for a ghost's abilities are limited. I'll have to find satisfaction with the fact that it was the Empire that disposed of my enemy.
I won't mention my name. We were stupid and reckless to agree to Skrakan's mad venture. I'm disgraced by my infamous and useless death, but no one must know of my disgrace. To the Imperials, all who died in the astral campaign are heroes. Let it be that way. The good of the Empire is above personal ambition!
But that's not what I want to talk to you about. It's the Sources you know as the Seals that's bothering me.
While I was held in the Pyramid, I had plenty of time to think. Besides, after he incarnated in a new body, Tep would often talk to us incorporeal ones, if only to taunt us. So I had enough food for thought. And some of my conclusions are scaring even me!

I hope you're brave enough to challenge the powers that caused my death. It's you and the other heroes who are responsible for the future of our great realm. Don't betray the memory of those who gave their lives for the Empire!
I don't expect you to easily believe my words. I wouldn't believe me either. But I have proof for everything I say.
Ask the Great Mage's soul about his surmises about the Seals and the Great Experiment.

Let me refrain from mentioning my name. It's disgraced forever! What we thought of as a great triumph proved a great disaster. Not even then did I take my mistake into account, and the blood of innocents was shed again because of me... The Great Astral Campaign... The Great Bloody Campaign... No, don't ask me anything! Those are deeds of a distant past, and I had enough time to realize the depth of my degradation. And my tormentor Tep contributed greatly to that. When he incarnated in a new body, he'd often torment my incorporeal spirit with tales of his great triumph that our mistake made possible.
You already know a lot about the Seals that we knew as the Sources. A lot, but not everything!
It won't be soon before I feel brave enough to face the descendants of those who perished on my account. You will be the one to relay to them my words. Use my knowledge as you deem appropriate, but don't make our mistake again. Don't let your pride cloud your mind!
I may be dead, but I cherish hope that my death at least partly redeemed the great debt of all the Great Mages since the Cataclysm!
I don't expect you to easily believe my words. I wouldn't believe me either. But I have proof for everything I say.
Open the cache in the Eye of the World, take the diary with the recording of the experiment and take it to Mark Staritsyn, the Keeper of Secrets.

The Eye of the World has a cache in it. It's unlikely to have been found, for I did my best to hide the documents. Look for a small bookcase with an obscenity carved in its wall. Don't worry, it's unlikely that anyone was able to paint it over. Read it backwards and the cache will open. Take the papers and use them as you deem appropriate. Burn them or go public with them if you want. But think carefully before you act, estimate the probable consequences. Remember: the Empire's future depends on you!
What the hell is that? Sensitivity level four zeroes. How did you get clearance to access such documents, eh? Come on, hand them over.

Well, I'll be... This is huge! Looks like the Great Mages have been lying to everybody for ages? First, they almost destroyed the world, and now... What now? Now they are prisoners to the pathetic scraps of land we know as the allods. If we keep in mind that they live forever... Aye, their self-imposed punishment is a cruel one. Eternal imprisonment - and voluntary one at that!
I guess it would have been better if you'd never found these records. They can split the Empire and turn the people against Yasker and the other Great Mages... That would mean the end of this world! There would be no holding back the demon menace!
I won't let that happen! For the Empire's sake, I'll take these papers from you and hide them in the most reliable deposit box in the deepest bunker. Trust me, that would be best for all. Knowledge is too dangerous, especially when it contradicts faith.
Open the cache in the tower in Novograd and take the Great Mage's diary to Lovewise Catfish.

I recorded The Great Experiment in detail for future generations, but I never had the courage to reveal the truth. I know that's cowardice, but the truth would mean the end of our world as we know it. A few mages were killed by the maddened commoners in the first years after the Cataclysm. Then the rebels died themselves, so there was no one left to protect their allods from the Astral. Just imagine what would have happened if I'd announced that it was us, the Great Mages, who killed this world? No, I could never do that. Yet the truth... The truth had to be kept.
There is a cache in the tower in the center of Novograd. There's a column in a hall on the second story, the floor dented at its foundation. Utter the words I'll tell you next to that column, and the cache will open. Use the papers inside as you deem appropriate, but remember that the truth can kill faster than the sharpest sword!
What? What's in these papers? Let me have a look...

I can't believe my eyes! Those mages arranged the Cataclysm and almost destroyed the whole world? I don't believe it! I don't want to believe! But the diary...
You know, here's what I think. It doesn't matter what actually happened. The Great Mages paid for their mistake already by becoming prisoners to their own allods. It's not up to you or me to judge them.
I'll keep these papers, hide them on the farthest shelf and do my very best to forget all about them. The people believe in the wisdom and power of the Great Mages, and that faith supports them better than any true knowledge. Sometimes it's better not to know, and sufficient to simply believe.

Tep... Till this day, I can't help but marvel at the power hidden in his madness. Who'd ever thought that someone who died once would almost succeed in pulling the whole world into nothingness with him?
I am scared by how easily Tep would extinguish his enemies. By how easily he created an entire world, albeit an illusory one. If that's not divine power, then it's very, very close. And I have an idea what the secret of his incredible power is. The Seals!
I know Tep had experimented with a small fragment of one of the Seals and derived the power to create his Plague from it. It is one of the manifestations of the Sources - the manifestation of Death. But the Pyramid... Illusions, energy, matter, creating new life and influencing the mind. A full set of powers accessible to the Great Mages, reinforced by extremely sophisticated spells. No, I don't believe Tep could achieve all that by himself. After all, until recently he was but a body howling in pain, suspended between life and death. I'm sure someone helped Tep! Someone who knows everything about our Great Experiment.
h: Ask the Great Mage's soul about Tep

t:
I think you already guessed the bitter truth, so I'm only scattering your last doubts. The Great Experiment and the Cataclysm are one and the same!
Blinded by our pride, we searched for ways to grow our power and we found the Sources. We had no idea then what the Seals were and why they were important. Every one of us the Great Mages wanted only one thing - power, free power!
 We tried to subdue the power of the Seals. When our first attempt failed, we continued to attack the Source Seal again and again with the most powerful spells till it cracked and gushed its power into the world. Power against power, understand? The Seals could not bear it, the world's shell cracked and the Astral put an end to the Sarnaut as I knew it. You know the rest - the world in ruins, the legend of the Patrons, the Great Mages being the last stronghold of order in a realm of chaos... But I see that you don't seem to believe my words.
It doesn't matter if you know about me. What matters is what I know about you!
Save Renat Idein, Sarang Naroo and Laurentine de Desirae from the sarcophaguses and use the June Ruins to send them to the Refuge.

That's a failure. We can only hope it won't be fatal for our cause. Well then, if Tep couldn't be taken care of in one fell swoop, let's continue to cut off his supplies. He has already lost the illusory world and the power plant, and we evacuated some of the prisoners. Our next target is the mechanoid factory. But first, we need to handle a very important task. I can't risk entrusting it to anyone but you.
Like I said, the evacuation of prisoners is running smoothly, but at this pace, it will take plenty of time. Meanwhile, there are experts among the prisoners whose help we need more than air: expert on the magic of the elements, Renat Idein, engineer Sarang Naroo, oracle Laurentine de Desirae. We need to get them out of the sarcophaguses and take them to the Refuge. Find them and escort them to the June Ruins. Don't let any wandering mechanoids come closer than a mile. Any questions? Then get started.
The lives of all of Tep's prisoners are important to us. But those three had to be here the day before yesterday!
Nice work! The prisoners are here, being briefed on the latest events. They'll be of great help... As soon as they recover from shock!
Where are we? What's going on?
Take 15 parts off the sarcophaguses in the Spark Pen and bring them to Pin the Crafty in the Refuge.

It's cool, the way you leap there and back! Now you're in our world, and the next moment you dive into illusion! Truth be told, I'm scared to even come close to the sarcophaguses: what if I get sucked in?! But scared or not, I need to keep them running. You probably have no idea of how your leaps affect our sarcophagus. It shakes, sparks, smells of burning... If it conks out, we have no tools to fix it. How will you travel into illusion then? Perhaps by the power of thought!
I heard you've been releasing captives left and right. Why don't you go there and take some parts off those sarcophaguses? Unscrew a nut here, remove an assembly there, and maybe we'll get enough parts for repairs!
I don't know how those sarcophaguses work and what parts can get damaged, so take all you can, just in case. Some reserve can never hurt, he he!
Good! Just what we need! This will do for a sarcophagus and a half. Now, if anything gets damaged, our eggheads will fix it in an instant.
Fight Tep's Cultists and Sacrificers in the Spark Pen, use the Sparkton Pack to obtain 12 Sparks of Tep's cultists and sacrificers and bring them to Charles de Doucer.

I'm sorry about the unsuccessful attack. That was exceptionally brave, but extremely reckless. How can... Never mind, I'm sorry, I didn't mean to lecture you. Frankly, I came to ask you for a favor once again. The fact is that Tep not only sucked the shining out of his slaves' Sparks. He also conducted some extremely weird experiments on them. Certainly, those Spark manipulations may have been just some cruel cookery, an attempt to make them tastier... Yet I'd like to know it for sure.
Take this device that extracts Sparks out of defeated enemies. It's also known as the Sparkton Pack. I'm asking you to fight the most loyal of Tep's servants, his cultists and sacrificers, and obtain a dozen of their Sparks. Let's see what Tep did to them and if they have anything human left within.
What? Are you asking if I have ever tasted another's Spark? Do you have any idea how tactless this question is? With your permission, I will refrain from replying.

Thank you. It's incredible: if things had gone a bit differently, that Sparkton Pack could have had my Spark in it, and you would have brought it... He he he, perhaps to Yasskul Nash! Fate is an amazing thing, but free will is a hundred times more amazing!
Thank you once again. You can get back to your business. If the Spark research reveals anything interesting, you will be the first to know!
Fight Tep's mechanical soldiers in the Spark Pen to obtain 15 Cleavers and bring them to Fleur de Ardeur in the Refuge.

May I disturb you? I need your help.
A few injured in the infirmary are suffering from a serious intoxication. The poison is literally eating them from within, but doctor Mafoo and I can't figure out what that poison is and how it should be treated. The patients say they were wounded while fighting Tep's mechanoids in the Spark Pen. I suspect they were poisoned by the venom those bastards had on their weapons. If I had samples, I could verify that theory and even try synthesizing an antidote. Alas, the Spark is at Irdrich's opposite end! Would you please go there, finish a few mechanical monsters and bring their weapons to me? I wouldn't distract you from your business, but the patients are in dire need of help. You won't leave your comrades in trouble, will you?
With Tep, you can expect absolutely anything. What if his poison affects both the bodies and the Sparks? I know, I know, this is nonsense from a scientific standpoint, but with Tep, who knows!
Thank you! Look, I was right: the blades are covered in some filth... I probably shouldn't start researching without a protective suit, gloves, and goggles.
Find out what awaits you beyond the portal.
Enter the portal, quick! Don't know how long I can hold it... Come on, don't delay!
Looks like the patient is alive rather than dead.
If you can hear me, try opening your eyes... That's good. Good morning. Although it's way past morning, and there's nothing good about it.
Take the key to the Black Pyramid's portal from the keeper and recalibrate it.

This portal looks pretty strange. It's very likely to work just like normal portals do, but Tep's genius scientists have improved it. It can now be used without the guardians' help. However, the portal is not directly connected to the main transport network. That can be fixed, though, if you have a special key. Only how do we get it?
If you can activate this portal, you'll be able to easily evade all Tep's patrols!
Success! Now this portal is connected to the main portal network. The mechanoids that crawl around the ruins will no longer prevent you from getting to Tep for a decisive battle.
Win a crab race. Use tailwind and avoid dead wind.

You like crab races? Sand everywhere... Ha ha, nevermind! That's in the past! I have bred the kind of crabs that make every other crab look like a snail. My crabs are so fast that they run on water! Imagine a race with those crabs! You'd need a rocket to keep up with them! You don't believe me? I'll show you! Here are the rocket and the crabs. I'm betting a pile of seashells that you won't be able to catch up with them!
To give you a sporting chance, I'll even tell you the secret of flying over the sea. It's all about air currents! Watch the air move over the water. Some winds are blowing into your back, and in some spots, the air is still. I'm only telling you this because I'm one hundred percent confident in my crabs: even if you catch all the favorable winds, you won't outrun Breeze or Thunder, and you won't even notice my beautiful Lightning before she's off! So are you flying? Or are your knees shaking already?
Take care not to go to the Astral! If something goes wrong, wave your hands and shout like crazy. It normally helps.
This surely is a grand exploit - to overrun a little crabbie on a rocket! Anyway, here's your reward.
I told you my crabs were the best of the best throughout whole Sarnaut!
Pretend to be a shark and scare other players while staying in the water.

They are laughing at me! They don't believe I'm doing useful work, watching out for hostile crabs. They say, "lazy Nile keeps making stuff up". If it wasn't for me, the crabs would have bitten off their feet!

You want to help me? Pretend to be a shark and scare one of them... Or three! Scare three of them so they know Nile isn't here for nothing, that Nile is looking out for them!
Swim up quietly to a bather, then jump out of the water and clatter your teeth! This way they will learn there are some dangerous creatures in these waters, too!
Haha, this is so much fun! Did you see how they twitched their feet and threw their hands up? Now they will know that Nile is no idler - Nile is watching out for enemies!
Meet Bup the Glassy, Ole the Hospitable and Dodo the Crabber, then return to Zouzou.

Welcome to our sunny island, traveler! Get ready to enjoy the best entertainment you can imagine!
We have all kinds of activities here: Bup the Glassy invites everyone to participate in his Tipsy Marathon. Zip the Wing-Footed is arranging a sporting event.
Dodo the Crabber has organized exciting crab races.
There is also deep-sea diving for those who like swimming -  you know, you can find amazing stuff on the seabed!
And of course, our atoll is famous for its Karah-Oki event! Everyone loves it! After all, everybody loves singing! The best performers will be rewarded generously.
So, I suggest you to take a walk around the island and meet our locals. Enjoy yourself!
Hope you are having a great time!
Great! Now you know the most significant persons of our tribe. If you want to have fun, don't be shy to ask them!
Meet Cola Speed, Deli Lightheart, Jack Cheap and Nile Waterwalk, then report to Zouzou "Seven Steps".

Welcome, welcome! Have you been here before? We've got so much new stuff! It's hard to list everything, but I'll try.
First, Cola Speed, our crab breeder, created a new type of crab. They can run on the surface of water! And they are so fast, they can outrun a rocket!
Second, we've got our own Squawker now! His caretaker is Deli Lightheart, talk to him when you have time. If you let him, he'll be telling you about wings and feathers all day long.
Third, there's Jack Cheap. He's a businessman who wants to be a Free Trader, but he's short of gold to do that. Keep your eyes peeled, or he'll clean you out.
And the last one that might be of interest is Nile Waterwalk. He's a strange guy. I have no idea what he's about. Maybe you can figure him out?
Go meet them all, and then come back to me for a welcome gift. Just for fun!
Everyone loves summer and the hot sun...
How do you like it here? All fun and play, right? Here's your gift.
Obtain cocktail recipes from any bartender, gather the fruits, mix 6 different cocktails and bring them to Zouzou.

Wanna learn how to mix cocktails? You've come to the right place!
In fact, it's very simple. We grow seven kinds of fruit on our wonderful atoll. Actually, nobody grows them, they do it on their own, and we pick the fruits. A good cocktail can only be made of fresh fruits!
You can also buy any cocktail from me, but it's much more fun to mix it by yourself! And tastier, too!
Ok, listen. We have pineapple, orange, papaya, banana, coconut, mango and nectarine on our island.
What's that, now? Yes, I know that coconut is a nut! One fell on my head once, and that's when I realized that it's a true nut! But that doesn't matter.
Anyway, get a list of recipes from any bartender, and collect the fruits. The more fruits you bring, the better. You'll be able to make more complex cocktails. Mix each of the six cocktails! You won't regret it, I promise!
The sea, the sun, and cocktails... What can be better?

Wow, you're a real bartender! Have you done it before?
Wow... Making a perfect Blue Lagoon and Hurricane at the first try... You've got a real talent!
Bring a bottle of rum to any bartender to receive your reward.

So the Tipsy Marathon is over.  There is still some buzzing in my head and my legs are moving on their own... But I got so many positive emotions in this amazing marathon!
This bottle of rum will be useful for mixing the most fancy cocktail of the season - an exhilarating Tropicana!
I just need to find a bartender who knows the recipe.
And here is our prize winner!

So, did you enjoy the marathon?
As we say in the Great Turtle tribe, "moderate drinking is harmless, in any quantities".
Now that you have the rum, I can mix for you one of the three versions of Tropicana cocktail. From now on, you are a real marathoneer! Choose the cocktail you like more.
Bring a bottle of rum to any bartender to receive your reward.

The Tipsy Marathon is the best entertainment here! I know what I'm talking about!
The rules are simple - drink a cocktail and go to the next bar. To which bar? The cocktail you've drunk will guide you! Follow Pint Potson! But you must get to the next bar before you sober up, or else you will have to start from the beginning. The drunker you are upon arrival, the more points you receive.
You can learn the details from me or from any bartender.
So, bottoms up?
How are you feeling, champion? Head buzzing? Don't worry, it will pass soon!
Have you failed? Oh but of course, you have to exercise a lot!
Take part in the athletic competition, pass all checkpoints and reach the finish line. Then talk to Zip the Wing-Footed.
Do you feel the burst of energy?

I love sports, running and swimming! And abstinence is a principle of a healthy life! Pity my folks don't think so.
I conduct an athletic competition every 3 minutes to prove my fellow tribesmen that sport is better that their drunken marathon!
Sports, not booze, turned a fish into a waterfolk!
Have you lost? I am sure you can win some other time.

Meh, Tipsy Marathon...  What kind of sport is this? Running from bar to bar drinking cocktails, next morning you wake up and your head is ringing like an empty seashell!

You lot should take better care of yourselves. A couple of days ago a company of orcs got so wasted here, they went for a walk in the jungle and got lost! We found some of them fallen asleep under the trees and some wandering helplessly among the palm trees... No thanks, I'm all for the healthy lifestyle.

That's why I'm inviting you to take part in my athletic competition. No alcohol, just running and swimming! All you have to do is follow the route, go through the checkpoints, and reach the finish line. If you make it in time, you'll receive a prize. If you don't, just catch your breath and try again.

Learn to pace yourself, know when to accelerate and when to slow down. Breathe evenly! If you run too fast, you will exhaust yourself.

I'll place tables with refreshments along the route. If you are too tired, have a drink on the run. Our drinks are full of vitamins. They are great for fighting fatigue.

Oh, I almost forgot! The competition starts at the time marked in your calendar.
Have you lost? I am sure you can win some other time.
Dive deep, find an underwater oasis, collect delicate crab feed hidden under stones, then return to Dodo.

Do you like swimming? My friends and I have invented a game - you hold your breath, dive deep and sit under water as long as possible. Whoever comes up last wins the prize! The point is to come up at the end... There were cases where we had to bring round some really persistent divers. But everything is all right, don't worry, nothing bad happened to anyone!
So, the diving contest. It turned out that sitting on the sea bottom is quite boring, so we decided to mix business with pleasure - dive in and pick up delicacies for our racing crabs!
There are various delicious weeds growing at the seabed under the stones. Crabs fancy them greatly. But you can't lift those stones alone, so you'd better dive with friends! Together you'll be able to turn even the biggest stones and pick up a lot of delicacies.
Why am I telling you all that? Just try it, you won't regret it!
My little crabs could use a treat... Have you found anything delicious?

That's more like it! Now that my crabs are full, they will run faster than Steeds!
So, do you want to participate and make a bet on a crab?
Sing Karah-Oki at the start of the hour.

Have fun! Drink all your belly can hold and sing from your heart!
There's nothing better than a good song.
Sing us a song, it doesn't matter if you don't know the lyrics, that's what we have Karah-Oki for. There are no outstanding singers among us, but we sing wholeheartedly.
And those who put their soul into performance deserves a reward! Join us and sing along!
You can also catch some bugs and butterflies to shoot colorful fireworks - it will surely improve your Karah-Oki experience! Fireworks during Karah-Oki can also earn you seashells!
We start singing at the beginning of every hour, so come and join us!
My Bonnie lies over the o-o-ocean, my Bonnie lies over the sea...

Ah, you are such an amazing singer!  I was on the verge of tears. What can I reward you with...
Oh, I know! I'll give you a special seashell with a gift inside. I'm not sure what's in there, but it has to be something useful. So it's going to be both a gift and a surprise!
I see you enjoyed Karah-Oki? Come again later, we'll sing again!
Don't feel blue. No one can always be a winner. Take a rest and try again.

Wow! You have a great gift for singing! It really tugs at heartstrings.
Here you go, lyrics for the next song. Don't mess up.
One... Two... Three... Go!

Oh! Karah-Oki is the most useful thing invented by the Waterfolk aside from the Hurricane cocktail.
Legend has it that the origin of Karah-Oki is associated with Oki the Thunderous, the most loud-voiced singer, and the Great Turtle who is peacefully sleeping at the bottom of the ocean. Oki knew only one song. But what a song it was! You could say it's our anthem! When he sang - he always sang when he was drunk, and Oki drank like a fish - you could hear him far beyond the island. Poor Oki's loud singing really got on the Great Turtle's nerves. She became angry and punished him. The old woman cast oblivion on poor Oki, and he forgot the words of our only song! What a tragedy... But that didn't stop us! We wrote the words of the song on boards and showed them to Oki whenever he started singing.
In the end, the Turtle forgave Oki, and everything ended well. And singing when you have lyrics showed to you? It stuck, and we named it Karah-Oki!
Do you want to participate? I'll handle the music and you will sing. You can do it! I believe in you.
Don't know the lyrics? Not a problem! Just watch me when you sing. I will show you the lyrics, so you can sing heartily without having to worry about anything. There are no bad songs, just bad listeners!
Just don't get carried away, otherwise it won't take long to get hoarse from Karah-Oki

Our Atoll must be the most beautiful place in Sarnaut! But guests would keep talking about some Irdrich. That their sea is warmer, their fruit juicier, the sun brighter... But it's like it's a different world, there's zero proof, just tales! And then some historians found a mysterious prehistorical egg in the depths of the Astral! They said our climate was perfect for hatching the egg. We took it, of course! After a while it hatched, and now we're the only ones who own a Squawker! He's totally tame, and he loves giving people rides! Do you want to see the bird's eye view of our atoll?
There's only one thing we expect from you during the flight. See, he's still in the middle of his training. And we have a tradition! Just listen, don't interrupt! We're teaching him to sing, so you'll have to encourage his singing by shooting fireworks into the sky. So he'll sing better and louder. Got it? If you do so, I'll reward you with seashells!
Squawker fly into the light of the dark black night...
So, how have you liked it? Great, right? Oh, I'd love to have such wings myself!
Careful! If you happen to fall, no one will be able to put you back together again.
Search seashells on the sea bottom and find a pearl.

Want to earn a few seashells? I have an offer for you!

There are pearl oysters on the bottom of the bay. I use pearls for various crafts. Bring me a pearl - you'll get a seashell. If you have seashells, you can purchase cool stuff from my brother Jack. And if you find something else in the oysters, you can keep it - I only need pearls.

Do we have a deal?
What a beautiful pearl! Here is your reward, as I promised. By the way, pearls always come in handy for me, so if you want, you can dive for pearls as often as you wish!
Make a bet on a crab at Dodo the Crabber.

Place your bets, ladies and gentlemen! Not so fast, I'm writing it down!
What? What bets? Crab races! The most popular pastime on our island.
See those six lanes? When the time comes, I will give a command and the crabs will start running. And the spectators will cheer the crabs on with shouts, applause, and pieces of crab treats.
If your crab comes first, you win.
So, are you willing to participate?
So how do you like crab races?

Fascinating, isn't it? The main thing is to remember the treats. Our crabs are terribly voracious! Dive deep into the sea and turn the stones to find the food for crabs. The tastiest bits are under those!
Hello! Do you want to enjoy the most spectacular and reckless gambling game of our island? Welcome to Crab Racing!

You’re weird. You don’t need neither gold nor thank you.

I’ll give something, nevertheless. Remember the thing we took away from Zayan de Desirae’s underground? Here it is! I hope you can make good use of it!

See you!
I remember you! Oh yes, yes, I do! And I remember something else from the past!

Do you understand what you’ve done? We were preparing the greatest experiment in the history of Sarnaut. It wsa nearly ready. This very artifact in your hands had to be feeding the whole thing with spell power.

We started the experiment, and failed. We hadn’t enough power. And the Grain of Protopower was just... gone. It disappeared.

We, great mages, tried to stop the failing experiment, but we couldn’t. You know the rest of it.

I’ll take the grain. It will help me restrain the power of the Castle, and finally break free.

Don’t blame yourself. Time cannot be comprehended by any living being. It was predestined to happen so. We shouldn’t have started the experiment, but what’s done, is done...
Tell Mark Staritsyn everything you know.

Oh, this is how it all turned out to be...

Do you remember how it all began? Backwater harbor in Eljune, pirates and their unreliable information... Chase after Klavdia... That's a curious person, by the way. Wherever she is, all kinds of big and dangerous things go on about her. And what about her enthusiastic blah blah, saying she's ruling Nihaz's power... This is very suspicious.

I don't like Nezeb's words, either. He's never been beating about the bush, always went straight to the point. What's changed? It looks like Sarnaut will not calm down, until it's torn into pieces. Just think of it! The Leper is one of Sarn's creations. It means it had equal right to exist in this world, as we do. The only flaw is that we wouldn't have been able to exist together, and we are not the ones to play with godly powers...

In this respect, I am not too much surprised by Catherina's madness. Frankly speaking, I don't quite understand how she managed to enter the Conclave, at all. She may go on ruling Umoir, and give up dreams of anything more than that. Now that the Veil is lifted, our hands are free and we may start operation! On behalf of the Empire, I commend you for successful completion of this mission.

As to faith, I have to mention that Catherina didn't turn to the demon from the start. Initially, she wanted to establish the power of the Light in Umoir, make the locals believe in it - and in her, as the Lightbringer. Believers and followers would have elevated her powers. I've been thinking, may be you succeeded, because a small cult of your person appeared, by the way. Remember all those, who asked for your help... Now it clicks, huh?

I think we may now go public. But not with everything - let's keep Nezeb's word a secret. Go to Mark Staritsyn and tell him, whatever you feel like telling.
Dark times are ahead... Use your chance and take a rest, before the Empire calls upon you again.

The longer I know you, the more interesting stories I hear! But you know, I'm about to believe every single word you say, even if it's totally unbelievable. To tell the truth, Yasker and the Committee do as well.

So, you've witnessed... what? Creation? An allod appeared out of nowhere, and you took part in creating it. Now this mysterious Leper - a new life that influences other lives... Now think of it - Sarn received his power from his followers! Simply from creatures who believed in him! This, exactly this, opened such vast opportunities for him.

Your effort of will made it possible for Nezeb and Skrakan to come to rescue. Any creator may become god-like, if their will is strong enough...

I feel sorry to hide and classify the information you have brought... But I will be waiting for news from you!
Tell Lovewise Catfish everything you know.

Poor Catherina...

I cannot start to think how miserable she feels. Sarn cheated on her, broke her spirit, turned her inside out and revealed to the whole world... Who's without sin, eh? She's conceited and short-tempered, all right, but all she cares about is law and order! She's diligently seeking power all the time - this is one thing that deserves respect!

We are unable to comprehend God's intentions. We, mages, tried once, and failed. Catherina wanted to establish the power of the Light in Umoir, make the locals believe in it - and in her, as the Lightbringer. Believers and followers would have elevated her powers. But she failed, too. There weren't too many loyal believers. However, you may memorize the fact: the more believers you have, the higher your powers are. It may help you in very dangerous situations.

Let me warn you. Listen to what Skrakan says. He's the wisest one in the universe! Give it a thought. What is this Klavdia's eternal travel? Why is Sarn striving to break free? What is it, apart from his madness and his followers? Beware!

The Leper will soon go, after we have separated it from Sarn. It will leave but a few bitter memories behind. I'm only afraid, that more trouble might come...

Go to Lovewise Catfish, tell him what I told you. Let all others learn this lesson, too.
The anxiety is in the air...

Unbelievable...

This is the ultimate creation, God's oeuvre! Out of sheer nothingness, create not a deserted stony allod, but a whole new life! Sarn is amazing. Long ago, when he was still sane, his creatures were truly beautiful.

Faith provides gods with power. Not only gods - common mortals, too. Faith and will are the key! We will not be able to fathom this mystery, until we give room to doubts. It is due to your willpower out there, in the Astral, Nezeb and Skrakan were able to come to your aid.

So, there is one thing that people are not ready to comprehend just yet. We ought to keep the scrolls of your legends in a bookcase, behind Aidenus' seal, and make sure it's safer than the one that's securing Sarn...
Meet Dmitry Gubarevsky in Upper City.

So great mages of either faction are unable to defeat the Leper. Alright, we will have to act on our own accord...

I studied the Firebird’s feather - it’s full of power able to burn down the Leper, if it were a little more in volume. That is, if we had the whole birdie, we could heal Umoir!

I think I heard Gubarevsky brothers mentioning seeing it on their father’s field. Now that I have the real feather in my very hands, I don’t doubt that the bird exists.

Gubarevskies will show you the way to their allod.
Meet Tale Teller in Lower City’s tavern.

Birdie, birdie... how do I extract your power and not kill you?.. Hmm. Let me think. Meanwhile...

The Outlaws give me pain in the head lately! They are wasting my people for nothing! Today, when the Leper is so active, I cannot afford this! And the Church just won't help, I tried negotiating with them, it was no good. I know Tale Teller has some relations with the Outlaws, so go and force him to help me!

Bring their negotiator to the plowman's hut - it's the neutral territory. My Commander will meet him there.
Why so sad, friend? I can see gloom on your face. Do you want me to tell you a funny story so that you would cheer up?
Get to the entrance to Outcasts’ settlement, praise the gods in the correct order, crack Tale Teller’s riddle and enter the hideout.

The Queen is smarter than her boyards, then. No wonder, her job is more complicated that pushing pens and papers. I'm sure it is a good thing that Catherina changed her mind and decided to sink a feud with the outlaws. Peace is good, I'll help you enter their village safely.

I'll give you a special mark that will protect you against their weapon. But it's half a deed. You must find the answer to a riddle before you can see their houses.

The wisdom and experience speak the most important work. Nobody objects to the word of wisdom. A silly girl might blurt out something stupid, but she'll be hissed at: know your place, listen to the wise and experienced elders! She will be silenced. There's also wisdom in her. She knows that the final word is hers. In the meantime, a hunter and a warrior would argue who's braver. Here's what I say, a poor peace is better than the good war. If your coffers are full of treasure, and your enemies are dead, only craftsmen with hands of gold are honored.

Go now. If you honor our ancient faith, my words will be no riddle to you. I will say no more, unless you want to hear an ancient tale or a legend.
How dare you come to our village without invitation, you? Just try and play your trick, make my day! No amulet will help you then!
Kill Chuden the Awakened and report to Vseslav the Wise.

To hell with you! I will have to die either way, so I don’t care whose help to accept.

The skies sent down a punishment to our village. An ancient evil has awaken, Chuden, it’s eating the guards and destroying our houses. It’s in the central square now, and I’m afraid it is going to lay us even with the ground! If your redemption is real, save us from this disaster!
I had never imagined me bowing to Catherina’s servant and thanking them for saving my life... Never say never.
We owe you our lives, true. You are welcome to ask for reward - we would love to pay you back!
Defeat 15 Sharptooth Gulpers near Covert Hide and report to Vseslav the Wise.

So, you are asking for peace for everybody? Isn’t it a bit too much, after all this blood spilt and sorrows caused?.. As long as I promised, I will have to think of it, anyway. Meanwhile, another service is required. There are too many corrupted beasts left.

There are so many of them about our Covert Hide, we cannot even stick out noses outside. You’ve heard rumors that the Leper won’t harm us, this is untrue. It’s only our faith that guards us against the Leper, but it is getting weaker by the day. Help us clear up the place.
Our enemies are a horde, but we know no fear!
Nice, nice, you are rather strong, stranger. There will be but one song and legend about your deeds and feats!
Defeat 15 Sharptooth Gulpers near Covert Hide and report to Chainislava Borderski.

There are so many of them about our Covert Hide, we cannot even stick out noses outside. You’ve heard rumors that the Leper won’t harm us, this is untrue. It’s only our faith that guards us against the Leper, but it is getting weaker by the day. Help us clear up the place.
Our enemies are a horde, but we know no fear!
Nice, nice, you are rather strong, stranger. There will be but one song and legend about your deeds and feats!
Return to Vseslav the Wise to Covert Hide.

If it turns out all right, I might even outpower Tep. You know why? Right, it’s faith!

Look, I saved the locals from the Leper and spent a whole ocean of power on that. Only godly power can defeat the Leper. Where should I get it? From the Astral? No thanks! Obtaining elemental power takes too long, and the power you get is too specific. Faith is quite a different source!

Faith will never end. The more people believe in you, the stonger support you feel, the more power you gain. Not many have the ability to use it properly, but any decent leader can sense it. I told the people that I saved a nice tale about Peregrina, and they were glad to trust it - so it’s not a tale any longer.

Noble Kanians believe in the goddess that wander about the universe. Naive Tekyan believe in goddess the creator. Harsh times await us, so I need all the faith I can get. Don’t you worry, I seek it not to feel my self importance, I seek it to really save the world.
What are you heavy thoughts, friend? Don’t tell me. I know our gods wouldn’t discover anything that is useless to you.
Take Vseslav the Wise to meet Ratmir Magman, the Commander, at Lower City outskirts.

So Catherina offers peace to us, undefeated? I would never have accepted it, never! If it weren’t for the Leper now.

I have made up my mind. I am going for the negotiations myself. There is no other way.

You say, the town commander will be waiting for me at the isolated farm? Let us go then. No time to waste.
Woe is me, so many corrupted beasts, you cannot even stick your nose outside!
You have arrived? This is good. I know Ratmir well enough, he’s fair and square, and will never do evil.
Find the source of the noise and return to Ratmir Magman.

Welcome, dear friend, may you days be filled by the Light and peace! I am so happy to discover that the ancient warfare between us has been forgotten! The Leper will not make any difference between you and us!

So, listen to the conditions, upon which Catherina, our great Queen, has agreed to... what’s that noise? I ordered the guards not to let anyone through!

What? Demons in Umoir? Are you out of your mind?

...

This is not a misery - this is the end! We’re done for...

There’s only one hole through which demons can come in. It’s the old portal used by the first demon ever. The one that turned Skrakan into stone. The demon has long been defeated and rot to dust, but the portal is still there in the tower. If it opens again, it means the enemy strikes right into our heart...
Try and get inside Skytower, then report to Vseslav the Wise, who is waiting for you near Lower City.

The demons came in through the secret portal in the tower. A cunning enemie sneaked inside the tower and opened the gates, that’s what it is.

Hurry to the Queen! Find out what happened! We are going to stay here and develop a plan of actions! If Catherina is harmed... no, I don’t even want to think about it. This will bring an end to Umoir...
So, is the news good or bad?
This is bad news indeed. So, the clockwork knights won’t let you into Catherina’s chambers? While the demons are in town? This is not clear...
Collect 10 Stoneberries and lay them in Pagan Shrine in Outcasts’ Hideout. When the Flying Fish arrives, jump on its back to ride up to the Skytower.

There’s only one way that I see. It’s dangerous, but there is no choice.

We don’t make friends with the Leper. That’s a lie. But we know the corrupted beasts well enough, and we are able to make them serve us, that’s true.

Have you seen the huge fish that can fly like a bird? We tamed it. It loves berries, and most of all, it loves stoneberry! If you gather a handful and lay it near the shrine, it will come to you immediately.

As soon as it has eaten, don’t you hesitate to ride it. Grab the whiskers and drive the way. And when you ride up to the tower, you’re on your own. The ring will help you.
You’re not in a hurry, are you? Really, I’d thought that demons will make you move faster.

I can see you’re surprised. Actually, there’s nothing to be surprised about. I didn’t start all this mess about young Peregrina, that local people love so much, just for the sake of it. Faith is power, remember? Dark times are coming, and I need every single grain of power I can get.

No time to talk. I never thought this about Catherina. She called upon powers, which she failed to rule - the demons and their Master. She's not strong enough to conquer Sarn... But no. I don't think Catherina would have ruined her own allod with the Leper.

We shall come into her chamber and find out everything. In case I am mistaken - you better go first. If I come in, she might be... unpleased with my appearance. And if it goes bad, touch the ring. The Wise man is on top of all gods. He'll help.

Why are you so surprised to hear that the old man is a local god? He's smart enough not to show off, you know.
Catherina turned out to be stronger than I’d thought...

We’re late! Now there is no doubt, Catherina serves Sarn, who started the Leper! I do not care whether is was a conscious decision or not, it’s important that Eclipse is about to sail off to the heart of the world, where Sarn is secluded. And believe me, she’s more than able to set him free by breaking just one of the seals! Nobody can stand against him. His release will bring Sarnaut to an end.
Bring 20 Thorn Weeds and 15 Pieces of Corrupted Flesh to Chainislava Borderski.

Wait! Please do something for me.

Our soldiers have been severely wounded by the corrupted beasts. Poison runs in their veins. If we don’t heal them, they will become corrupted, too!

I know many secrets, I can heal many diseases, but I’ve never seen any such thing. Bring me Thorn Weed to ease the pain and the Corrupted Flesh to brew antidote!
The wounded are feeling worse by the hour. I’m so scared I cannot hold a weapon.
Thank you so much! Everybody will heal now!
Bring 20 Thorn Weeds and 15 Pieces of Corrupted Flesh to Chainislava Borderski.

Our soldiers have been severely wounded by the corrupted beasts. Poison runs in their veins. If we don’t heal them, they will become corrupted, too!

I know many secrets, I can heal many diseases, but I’ve never seen any such thing. Bring me Thorn Weed to ease the pain and the Corrupted Flesh to brew antidote!
The wounded are feeling worse by the hour. I’m so scared I cannot hold a weapon.
Thank you so much! Everybody will heal now! If you want to help again, bring me more thorn weeds and corrupted flesh. I can always make good use of it.
Kill Barren Flower and take the ring from his belly. Bring the ring to Glum Bogdanov.

The moment that the corrupted monsters attacked our home, I took out my sword at once and started smashing them, and crushing them, and slicing them, and... you get the idea. They’ve been arriving in waves, and one of the bastards sneaked from the behind, and bit me on the hand! I dropped the sword then and ran. It’s no grief that I lost three fingers and the sword. It’s the grief that I lost a wedding ring with one of the fingers. The ring that my beloved fiancee gave me! The only thing I dream about is to get it back, and now that I cannot hold a weapon, how can I do this?.. Will you help me?
So you’ve got the ring, after all!
I would give anything for the ring. Take the reward. I’m going to my fiancee now, she’ll be so happy!
Find the gang leader near the portal.

Oh my, this was a big fight!
All the bodies are those of mercenaries, and they were killed with common weapons, although traces of powerful magic can still be seen. Klavdia and her mercenaries came across... who? Are there any survivors? The bag’s empty, no reply.
Look, there are tracks that lead away from the battlefield. We have to follow the survivors and find out what’d happened.
Don’t be too hard on me! It’s not my fault, whatever it is!

Klavdia? Is that the crazy woman in greenish rugs? So that’s how this cold blooded killer called.
We once dug into an old cellar full of gold, and just as we started grabbing the coins, I guess, we nudged some kind of an old portal, that’s what we did. Ruins, you know... So the portal activated, and a bunch of cutthroats with this Klavdia entered the cellar.
They noticed us in an instant, and we were forced to accept the fight. The thugs were easy to beat, but not her! She’s real crazy, I tell you! Her spells made half of my guys fall into ashes right at the spot. And then she just left. Just like that.
Where she headed, I wouldn’t want to know that, but I guess, to Skytower. Where else? I suggest you ask Krie, she’s wise and sees many things.
I smell a stranger’s spirit! Choo! Who are you?
That’s what it is... So what are you doing here?

I will help you heal from the Leper - I am a wise witch and a healer, after all. But you will have to help me. Listen.
The Leper cannot be removed completely. It can only be stopped, frozen. I will brew you a potion, a magic one, stronger than the Leper itself! You will bring me the ingredients.
First, collect some water from the river that flows from the roots of an old oak. The water is black as night and cold as starlight, but it’s very potent.
Pick up some corrupted mushrooms, flowers and roots. And mind you, you cannot bring too much! Go now!

Boil slime boil
Drip and drop and bubble
Ancient magic dark magic
Curle smoke in my cauldron!
Burn fire burn
Cough cough, oh my, this verse is so weird!

Here are the last ingredients!
A pinch of pollen, a drop of water, mushroom cap, mix it all... Achoo!
I’m allergic to pollen, see?
Find out what happened to the woods.
Looks like a wicked and strong magic to me. Even bushes are trying to bite you, ouch. Pinch a bit of it and show it to someone who might know something.
What is this thing? Throw that away and never touch the corrupted plantes with your bare hands again!
See this blue spot near your finger? That’s the Leper. It got you. Start searching for a nice cozy coffin, dear.
Bring Krie 12 Bunny Ears and 20 Owl Feathers.

My memory let me down again. I forgot to mention another ingredient, absolutely needed one! Or two, to be exact. Without them, it’ll be just a waste of time and effort.
Bring me a hare’s ear and an owl’s feather. Don’t mix them up! Hare’s feather won’t do, although you can find a beak and a hoof on a hare today. Nevermind, just bring me everything they’ll let you pluck from them.

Boil brew boil
Blood in my cauldron
Burn fire burn
As if you are in hell!
I don’t like the sound of it, either. Traditions, see?

Can you feel the smell? Not here, it’s my toilet!
No, it’s not the same smell. Not the same, I tell you!
Kill 10 Taksas near the witch’s hut.

You know what else? As you’ll be killing the innocent beasties, look out! I’ve seen wicked wild animals recently, that look like wolves, teeth like knives and legs enough for two. It’s been three days that they howl around my house in the night. I pray to all gods to survive through the night.
If you kill them all, I will be so thankful!
I have heard them scream and howl. Have they all gone? I’m so happy.

You a like a child. Always pick up dirt. It’s good you’re not trying to put it in your mouth.

Everything in this land has become corrupted. Every little thing, humans, animals, trees and flowers, all turn into dread. We call this disease "Leper". Only gods know how to cure it. We’ve tried both fire and wizardry, all in vain. Even Catherina herself, the Queen of Umoir, is only able as much as to restrain it, not to turn it the other way round.

This is not a good time to visit this place...
Kill the Mutant Toad and bring its eye to Krie.

Very little left to do, dear. Just one last ingredient. We need an eyeball, and not just an eyeball, but a really huge one.

I used to take Cyclop’s eye for this purpose, but now Cyclops are extinct at Umoir. Nevertheless, I noticed an enormous toad croaking in a spring at the forest edge. It was really massive, like a house in size, with its eyes like barrels! This eyeball will do fine.
Go and bring me the eyeball!
Oh my, it stares so... coldly. Like a toad.

Right... Two pinches of ground dried rib of a virgin, a fistful of hair of a noble robber, two teaspoons of camel’s thorns... Achoo!

This brew is really strong, see? It’s all ready, have some. Don’t wince, go on, at one gulp. Regard it as medicine against the Leper!
How do you feel now, snouty face? How much I would like to punch you! I wish I had time for that. Welcome to our fortress.

Come round!

Now listen to me. They were about to execute you, because you have come from the outside, and they hate the spies. While they were discussing your fate, the outlaws attacked.

Now they promise you freedom in exchange for 5 enemies’ lives. You are a decent fighter, as I can see, so now go and be so kind to help us. Don’t try to flee, we’ll make sure to catch you!
So, what should I call you, dear guest?
Are you the wild one who is supposed to appear from the thicket? How curious. I’ve heard a lot about you. So, what brought you here?
Deal with the consequences of outlaws’ attack.

I think I can help in your search. If your runaway is still here, she’s got nowhere to escape. Not without my permission.

But first you have to help me set everything in order after the attack. The faster you do, the quicker I’ll find your girl.
Let’s go into my chamber and talk.

Oh dear, oh dear, my beloved sisters have gone missing! Damned outlaws captured my Sissie and Cindy, and dragged them into the dark forest! I barely escaped!

Please, bring them back, I pray to the Light that you do! They won’t survive in the forest alone, even if they escape from the prison!
Don’t waste time! They are suffering in prison!
Oh thank you so much! If it weren’t for you, my dear girls would have died! Now they are home, and my family is forever in your debt!
Thank you! What would I have done without you? My mother and father will be so happy!

This is such a strange decoration. Made unskillfully, but with so much love... The symbols depict a nosediving bird or a thunderbolt.

Its previous owner valued it pretty much, I guess. It must be bound to the outlaws' faith. Find someone who can tell you more about the outlaws and their clash with the church of the Light.
What do you want to hear from me?
Use the pitchfork to tune guardian stones and return to Ratmir Magman .

Long ago, when the Skytower stood on the ground, there were ancient sentries that guarded the roads. They burned uninvited guests with lightning!

The spirits have long left their stones, but I still hope to return them. Their lightnings were so good!

I’m going to give you a device I recently discovered. I think Skrakan used it to turn the stones on and off. I tried to use it myself, but failed, I’m not good at magic, and my ears are rather old to hear things. Try it, will you?
This is perfect! No enemy will enter town now!
Destroy the rebels and their leader.

So was it the Queen who sent you to help us? You’re a good fighter, I’ve seen you crashing enemies.

The outlaws might still come back. They are dangerous. Your task is to shoo them off the town, forever. Find their hideout and kill them all, and their leader, especially their leader!
Edward, Edward... You shouldn’t have opposed the Queen...
Heads are rolling? This is so sad to say goodbye to life for the old dusty idols...
Return 30 stolen gems to Miluta Fastman.

Ho you mighty warrior! ‘Tis plain you will to spill the blood of the damned robbers, but wait! Relieve my heart, I have a plea for you!
My name would be Miluta Fastman, I am Goldie Nickel’s trade clark. I was carrying precious gems in my pocket, but they were not simple gems, but starry gems, very expensive, really rare, thirty of them. And then, it was my bad luck to come across these poor outcasts on a narrow track! I was about to say goodbye to life, but no, they merely gave me a clip on the jaw and let go of me. They took the gems! I will never be able to pay for them! Bring them back! I promise, I will owe you forever!
Have you found what I had lost?

You’re the savior!
Er, how many gems are there? All thirty, right? And I managed to hide a couple in the mouth, hm... If the trader asks you how many, tell him there were thirty, and you don’t know about the rest! I’ll pay your silence well.
Extinguish 4 fires in the Lower City and report to Barbara Brie.

Fire! Fire! Help!

Don’t just stand there, grab the bucket, run for water! The Queen will go crazy if the fire runs off to town!
Extinguish fire in the Lower City.
Extinguish fire in the Lower City.

I'm surprised to see an Imperial soldier. May be I should chop off your head, eh? Or are you telling the truth? Are you or are you not?

I can see traces of the Leper at your face. It means I'm your only chance. Oh well, you have to seek friendship of the powerful mage, who knows the secret... and the mage is not Yasker. See what I mean?

If it weren’t for the Leper that cut off Skytower, Upper city and Lower City from the rest of the world, these outlaws would have been eliminated a long time ago. Only their father’s land keeps them alive... so far.

So old fool Aidenus sent you looking to make trouble to me. May be I should just chop your head off and forget about it, huh?.. But Klavdia may be a problem, that's true. You're not lying to me, are you? Don't even think of it!

I can see traces of the Leper on your face. It means I'm your only chance. Oh well, you have to seek friendship of the powerful mage, who knows the secret... and the mage is not Aidenus. See what I mean?

If it weren’t for the Leper that cut off Skytower, Upper city and Lower City from the rest of the world, these outlaws would have been eliminated a long time ago. Only their father’s land keeps them alive... so far.

You don’t want to get corrupted and stay in the Umoir forests forever, right? Listen to me then.
The Leper doesn’t kill. It transforms, corrupts, modifies, turns inside out not only your body, but your very Spark. The further, the faster.
First of all, we have to understand how deep the Leper is in your body. The most accurate test is to see your abilities in combat.
Say when you’re ready to fight, I’ll summon a poor creature for you to take apart.

How curious! I’ve never seen such a manifestation of the Leper!
Have you brought any alterations into your body before you met the Leper? Have you ever drunk Dragon’s blood, for instance? You have? I knew it!
I haven’t figured out how the Leper works yet, but I am positive that the source of it is the Astral - and who would resist the Astral best of all? Dragons! Their blood produces very strange effects, which you have just shown. Ah, anyway, the Leper is unlikely to make good to you. It might heal by itself or cause weird mutations, this is totally unpredictible. The impact of the Astral on the living matter hasn’t been studied enough, you know.

I’ll give you an artifact that is supposedly able to control the spread of the Leper across your body. It’s up to you to decide when to use it. And I’m not certain about the side effects, so make sure not to overuse it, or it might kill you on the spot, see?

I guess that places us in the same boat! You'll have to help me until I find the way to get rid of the Leper then. Unless you want to see how it progresses, huh.

You're not eager, eh? I understand. So, you're helping me lift the curse from my allod, I'm helping you lift the curse from your body. Deal?

Let it be so! Let the Light witness our agreement!

As long as we're partners now, I'll tell you about my future plans.

I'm sure the Leper is somehow connected with the rebellious pagans that fled into the woods from the True Light. Their rage gave birth to the Leper, and I still haven't found the way to cure it.

I give no doubt that it's merely a matter of time. There are no things that cannot be turned back by a Great Mage! Whatever they might say!

The Leper is spreading outside Umoir, and your story submits the fact. So we need to restore the Veil of Mystery, also known as the Mystery Seal to stop the disease.

It's a pity Skrakan has long died, and the knowledge died along with him. And I don't want to raise the dead and talk to the rot!

If the rumors don't lie, you're used to talking to them. So it will be your task.

Kidding. Rumors are rumors, I know. All you have to do is find a wizard who lives at one of Umoir islands. He's able to talk to the dead. I don't know how you'll find him and persuade him to help you - it's not my problem. Talk to Anton, he's going to give you directions. And take one of my knights to assist you.

Catherina, our Queen, is not just a great mage, she’s an outstanding inventor! The flying Skytower and clockwork army are her creations!

All the latest gadgets, however, cannot compare with the Astral Hangar and Eclipse!

Eclipse will be ready soon enough! Dragon blood will protect it agains the Astral, fancy that! I can’t wait for it to sail!

Right now, there are a few ships available for sailing. Take Dawn, for instance, it rides fast as wind!
Find the ghost of the dead servant of Skrakan, ask him about Veil of Mystery and return to Catherina.

Your head is full of words of the dead language? It is good! It means we have a chance to squeeze the information from someone who knows about the Veil of Mystery.
Have you ever heard about Plagot? It’s where the gates you entered are. It used to be the largest city of Umoir, and now it lies in ruins, and silent ghosts are hovering over the dead city. Silent for all, but not for you!
I’m sure that among the ghosts there’s someone who used to know Skrakan. They will be useful to us!
Have you been able to find any information about the Veil of Mystery? We badly need it to stop the Leper!

The book? It’s Skrakan’s diary! You have no idea how valuable it is! It might keep secrets of the Universe! An the way to the heart of the world!
Let me see, what it’s saying about the Veil... How curious... Damn it! The old fool cast a bloody spell on that! May the Light punish him!
Find ghost’s voice and bring it back to the ghost.

He’s silent, and all he does is stare. He lost his voice somewhere. He’s gesturing at you. Is it a beer keg? Or a big belly? Or both?

It might show the way to return the voice to the ghost.
The Ghost is silent and looks really sad and depressed.
Ugh ugh. It’ so relieving to hear your own voice once again! Thank you, stranger. I guess I owe you now? Tell me what you want and go, a living shouldn’t be long among the dead.
Dispel menhirs’ magic and return to the old man’s ghost.

Don’t be so fast. Skrakan’s notes! Not so fast, I tell you.

Who told you I know about them? The Queen? I’ve seen one lady lately, so noisy! I asked her to be quiet, but she just waved her hand at me, and I lost my voice at once!

Everyone awakened, everyone who had slept for a century! Sentries, guards, even the tavern keeper! I hate it.

She touched stones, so I think she charmed them somehow. If you dispel her magic, I guess, all the dead will return to their graves. Then I’ll tell you where Skrakan servant lies. He should know more.
Don’t hurry, I ain’t going nowhere.
This is so quiet now! I’m alone, this feels so good.
Take the ghost to the place where Skrakan lies, take the book and return to Catherina.

My word is stone! I said means I did! So, the grave of the servant is... the grave of the servant is... it is situated... holy mother, I forgot! Completely forgot! Under the wall? Or near the fountain? Or behind the tavern? Damn it.
You have still got my word. We’re going to find it, that’s for sure. You walk ahead, I’ll follow, and as soon as we come across the familiar place, I’ll let you know.
Have they arrived? Or have they not?
The skeleton is holding a book in his bony hand. The book is really old and bettered, but the handwriting definitely belongs to Skrakan.
Meet Radigost Ploughman in the field to the east of Lower City.

Oh mighty warrior, please, do not leave us poor bodies without your help ad support! I’m a simple little girl, no nobles will ever listen to what I say!..
Only you can help the poor girl. Haregons are eating our field away, and I’m a girl, and my dad’s an old man, there’s nothing we can do about them. Please, help us get rid of them!
Just walk toward the lake, you cannot miss our house.
Get rid of haregons and return to Radigost.

Isn’t she stupid, that girl? Sending a hero to help! A whole hero! I could hire two boys for a dime, it’d’ve taken them an hour to get me rid of haregons...
Well, as long as you’re here, you are to do it. Please.
I can’t thank you enough! You’ve saved us! I will harvest now, and buy my daughter red shoes and a ribbon for her hair! She will look so beautiful!
Collect 25 historical artifacts in Plagot ruins and bring them to Finn Sacker.

Hey! Psst! Come here! Quiet! Do you want to earn some? I’ve got a business for you. I am an achrenologist, you see. It’s a science, the achrenology, it’s about digging for stuff, you know, ancient and dusty, all kinds of jugs, and rugs, and coins, all this. Drag em all to me, you know, to develop science and study the old days, and for the glory of the Light, of course.
When the demons attacked, the people just ran, they flee, you know, and dropped all their belongings just like that. So just pick it up and bring it to me. For the sake of achrenology, of course.
Got rarities? What if I find ‘em?
You’re an achrenologist for real! Dug up for stuff, and all! Business is business, you get the reward, I get the stuff, huh huh.
Kill 10 hungry Werebears and report to Avadhuta.

I’ve got another task for you. It’s not even a task, it’s nothing for you. There’s a fool in ruins, called Avadhuta. He always drags stuff from the ruins to me, and sometimes he can even bring in something valuable.

It’s too bad there are so many werebears there. I’m afraid they might eat him...

You will go there anyway, do a good thing, will you? Kill about ten werebears, and tell Avadhuta it’s clear. Let him drag more!

Avadhuta out of big house, Avadhuta out of small house, that was not fair. Now Avadhuta lives here, no sorrow, no pain no more. Avadhuta is no fool, will go to no town, no city again. Avadhuta knows a tale about a prince and a monster. Prince hit the monster on the face, and monster grab prince, and prince hit monster with a club, and monster bite prince, and prince hit monster with an axe! The monster dies!

Now Avadhuta go search for scraps, and shards, and pieces of glass. Finn is good, Finn makes no pain to Avadhuta. He gave Avadhuta a candy, sugar candy! Will give more, if Avadhuta brings him more shiny shards!
Cure the fool from voices in the head, then return to Avadhuta.

Demons, demons everywhere! See, there’s one! And there’s another! They laugh, they dance, they are there! Everyone thinks they have disappeared, but they haven’t! Avadhuta can see them nice and clear!
Avadhuta would beat them again, but no sword, no knife! You’ve got one? What are you waiting for! Make them shut up! Avadhuta no wants to hear them any more!
Damn you, you give no peace to Avadhuta!
Hear! Shouts and moans are heard no more! Demons are gone, now Avadhuta may sleep in peace for a day, and another day, and another.
Don’t hit me! I’m going to cry!
Avadhuta had a book! Colorful! With pictures! But the guards took it away and said bad words. Avadhuta is going to cut their heads off, nobody says bad words any more.
Meet Radigost Ploughman in the field to the east of Lower City.

Oh mighty warrior, please, do not leave us poor bodies without your help ad support! I’m a simple little girl, no nobles will ever listen to what I say!..

Only you can help the poor girl. Haregons are eating our field away, and I’m a girl, and my dad’s an old man, there’s nothing we can do about them. Please, help us get rid of them!

Woe has come, never expected! Forgive me, hero, for distracting you from your combat deeds, but see for yourself, what trouble we’re having here... Poor white fluffy rabbits became so corrupted by the Leper, they’re able to tear a human into pieces.
Get rid of haregons and return to Radigost.

The hares are back. And they are no normal hares - they look more like dragons. Haregons, that is.

I can’t defeat them on my own. Please, help the old man to clear his field! I will pay you back and tell everybody how strong and brave you are!
You escaped being bitten by angry haregons? I’m so relieved.

If it weren’t for you, my daughter and I would have been ruined! Thank you for saving us from the trouble. And if they ever come back, now I know I’ve got such a good defender! I can tell whole Umoir about your bravery!
Go to the old ritual hall at the bottom of the lake and prepare if for the ritual, so that Catherina could restore the Veil of Mystery.

It wasn’t such a good idea, to base such a powerful spell on blood! Its quality greatly depends on external factors, which are highly unstable!
I bet the great Mage’s blood will do. However, we need to take care of the safety. There should be an old ritual hall in the basement of the Skytower - old Skrakan was very peculiar about the rituals. Most of the basement is under Starry lake’s waters, but the entrance is clear. Go there, find the hall, make it up and help me lift the veil of this mystery.
Bloody rituals are extremely powerful, although complex and unstable. The slightest mistake will cost me a life. Don't distract me!

I swear to the Light, if Skrakan were alive, I'd have killed him with my hands!
He never used his own blood to seal the ritual. He took someone else's blood instead, blood of a mortal... Hmm... I wonder if I should open up your veins and give your blood a try... But no. You should have been aware, if it were yours.
Let's return. I need to think.

Catherina receives Skrakan's notes and finds out that she would need power of Umoir royal blood to create the Veil of Mystery. She thinks that Great Mage's blood might do. She's asking the player to perform the ritual. It takes place at the lake under the Upper City. The player will have to run around the location, use context actions, and kill the mobs that spawn. The ritual fails.
Find nanny in Upper City. She might know where Yelisseus is.

Let me think. If my blood won’t do, why is that? The object of the spell must possess certain traits, whick I evidently lack. What would that be, besides the fact that I’m the great Mage, and the power of my single nail overcomes the power of all the feetlickers put together?
It is rather obvious, isn’t it? I was born outside Umoir. All the blood-based spells must be blood-bound to the place. Pure logic. We need a representative of the ancient Umoir nobility... which is extinct by the day. Not so good, eh?
But wait! There should be Yelisseus! He has gone missing long ago, and nobody has seen him ever since. You must find him. And don’t come back before you do!
Are you looking for my Yelisseus? What’s the point for me talking to you? I told this many times to the Queen’s agents: I have no idea where he is!
Meet Catherina in the ritual hall to complete the ritual.

You got the blood? Perfect. Where’s Yelisseus? We might need more blood.

If it goes as it should go, this time we might face old guardian spells, cast by Skrakan to prevent anyone from repeating the magic and destroy the Veil of Mystery. I won’t be able to distract during the ritual, so our safety is your responsibility.

Meet me in the ritual hall.
Rituals are outdated. Technomagic owns the future!

I’m so tired. I never knew ancient rituals suck so much power out of you... Where has this ghost come from? A protective spell cannot materialise in shape of the creator! This is impossible!

I’ll take care of it later. We have more important things to do now. Return to my chamber, we’ll talk about our further actions.
Kill Ussa Horbam and his helpers in Upper City, then return to Jade Gloom.

I heard about your brave deeds!
We’ve got a trouble here: some thiefs came to steal, to rob, to set on fire, to hurt the honest men. That’s not too good, I say. Not smart at all.
It’s evident they cannot stay. No thief would live in peace in the same forest with the wolf, see what I’m saying? I have to get rid of them. Understand? Nice. Their leader’s name is Ussa Horbam - I’m going to bury this one with special honor, ha ha.
It's not smart to tangle with the honest men, not smart at all.
I bet Ussa Horbam feels like in heaven now.
